M11 — 2026-10-09
Replay a hook against another repo's records without touching them: copy each .sofar/initiatives/<slug>/events.jsonl into a scratch root, keeping only lines whose ts is before the moment under test, then run `echo '<hook json>' | sofar-core event session-start|user-prompt` (TS: `SOFAR_CORE=0 node packages/engine/dist/cli.js event …`) with cwd at the scratch root. The session_id must be HOMED in the record under test (its latest session_started), or the hook serves wherever the session last re-homed. Restore .sofar between engine runs, because told sets make a second run quiet.
